files.initialPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a high-resolution PORTRAIT 2:3 background illustration for a mobile reading page of Chaeksa, an elegant Korean fortune-reading website.
Input image 1 is the exact male character identity and painting style reference. Input image 2 is ONLY the library architecture, daylight and materials reference, not a request to copy the two-person layout.
Create ONE immersive vertical illustration of the SAME handsome adult man from image 1, in a sunlit ivory and warm wood library. Lock his face: same amber brown open eyes, fine straight nose, softly parted lips, wavy dark short hair, silver ear ornament, same age and proportions. Keep the intricate emerald, ivory and gold robes and dark embossed book. Draw ONE man only, naturally holding ONE open book with exactly two arms and two natural hands, no demonstrative gestures. He is a guide looking gently toward the reader, not a religious icon.
Composition designed for mobile art direction: medium waist-up portrait, character and book concentrated in upper 58% of canvas; head centered at x=52%, y=24%; entire head, BOTH shoulders, elbows and book safely inside the central 76% width; head not oversized. Top 10% is quiet architecture. Behind him subtle shelves, one tall sunlit arched window and restrained brass details form a convincing continuous environment, no cutout/sticker appearance. Bottom 35% is unoccupied softly sunlit ivory stone and warm paper-coloured atmospheric space, with progressively fewer details, allowing CSS to blend into a reading page. No objects, body parts, furniture or face in the bottom quarter. The visual subject should remain legible when the side 10% or bottom 25% is trimmed on a phone.
Style: EXACT same refined contemporary romantic fantasy/tarot illustration rendering as reference 1, crisp drawn hair, expressive clean eyes, fine engraved gold work, subtle natural textile texture, rich original greens and warm golds. Sharp illustrated detail, NOT photography, NOT classical oil, NOT watercolor wash, not chibi. Fine architectural setting from reference 2 but much calmer, less ornate, subject one step away instead of huge close-up.
No text, numbers, card border, panel borders, logos, watermark, smartphones, clocks, UI, decorative floating symbols. Maintain the identity and beautiful drawing quality of image 1. Output a single portrait image, opaque background.
